_comment: Python profile shim — composes the universal gates: github-fast-checks (Tier 1, dev/feature pushes ~18s: secrets+lint+tests+audit across py/node/go/php/deno) + github-release-heavy (Tier 3, prod pushes/tags deterministic: image/SBOM/license/zizmor/migration/contract/perf/build). Pure composition recipe + perf test fixture — ships NO workflow file of its own; exactly one workflow per tier exists in gated repos.
name: github-ci-security-python
description: Python gate via universal tiers: fast-checks (dev/feature pushes, ~18s universal) + release-heavy (prod pushes/tags, deterministic). Composition recipe only — no extra workflow file.

variables.name: gitleaks_version
variables.description: Pinned gitleaks release (asset names are versioned — never /latest)

variables.name: perf_test_path
variables.description: Perf-smoke test file path (consumed by github-release-heavy)

variables.name: license_denylist
variables.description: Comma-separated license IDs that block deployment

variables.name: image_size_budget_mb
variables.description: Docker image size budget (MB) — fails if exceeded

variables.name: prod_branches
variables.description: Comma-separated production-level branch names (T3 push trigger; T1 excludes them)

variables.name: staging_branch
variables.description: Staging-level branch name (T2 push trigger; T1 excludes it)

notes: Shim composing universal tiered gates mapped to branch levels: Tier 1 github-fast-checks (dev-level + feature-branch pushes ~18s: gitleaks secrets, ruff/eslint/vet/php-l/deno-lint, pytest/npm-test/go-test, pip-audit/npm-audit/govulncheck/composer-audit high-only) + Tier 3 github-release-heavy (prod-level pushes + tags v*: trivy image+budget+digest, CycloneDX SBOM py/node/go/php/deno + license denylist, env-audit, zizmor low, alembic drift/migration DDL+downgrade, config-validation, adaptive endpoint-smoke 200/404/503, graceful-shutdown, oasdiff contract diff, perf-benchmark, build+asset integrity, tests-detected, rollback-readiness). Branch names come from prod_branches/staging_branch variables (.harness-ci.json at install time). Ships no workflow file of its own — a future dedicated SAST tier would be authored as its own template. Docs-only pushes skip everything.
